description: This file implements a CRM service class for Zoho Bigin, handling authentication, contact and event management, token refresh, and API interactions.

classes.name: BiginCrmService
classes.description: A class implementing CRM interface for Zoho Bigin, managing authentication, contacts, events, and API interactions.

methods.name: biginAuth
methods.description: Authenticates with Zoho Bigin using provided credentials, returning a token getter.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth token when expired, updating stored credentials.

methods.name: createContacts
methods.description: Creates new contacts in Zoho Bigin based on provided contact info.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Retrieves existing contacts from Zoho Bigin by email.

methods.name: createBiginEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event in Zoho Bigin.

methods.name: handleEventCreation
methods.description: Orchestrates creation of a new event and contacts in Zoho Bigin.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event in Zoho Bigin, including contacts.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event in Zoho Bigin.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event in Zoho Bigin.
